tool.name: sincei scFilterBarcodes
tool.description: detect and filter cell barcodes in a BAM file
tool.command: @PREPARE_SINGLE_BAM@ scFilterBarcodes --bamfile input.bam --outFile '$barcodes_out' @CELL_TAG_CMD@ --binSize $binSize --minCount $minCount #if $whitelist: --whitelist '$whitelist' #if str($minHammingDist) not in ('', 'None'): --minHammingDist $minHammingDist #end if #end if #if str($minMappingQuality) not in ('', 'None'): --minMappingQuality $minMappingQuality #end if #if str($rankPlot) != 'none': --rankPlot 'rank_plot.$rankPlot' #end if @EXCLUSION_CMD@ @THREADS@ #if str($rankPlot) != 'none': && mv 'rank_plot.$rankPlot' '$rank_plot' #end if

param.label: Whitelist
param.help: A single-column file containing the whitelist of barcodes to be used. If not set, every barcode found in the cell tag is reported.

param.label: Minimum hamming distance
param.help: Minimum hamming distance to match the barcode in whitelist: barcodes within this distance of a whitelist entry are matched. Note that increasing the hamming distance really slows down the barcode detection process. Only used with a whitelist.

param.label: Minimum count
param.help: Minimum no. of bins with non-zero counts, in order to report a barcode. Note that this number should range from 0 to genome size/bin size. Barcodes with fewer bins are not selected.

param.label: Minimum mapping quality
param.help: If set, only reads that have a mapping quality score of at least this are considered.

param.label: Rank plot
param.help: Plot the ranked counts per barcode (similar to the knee plot, but counts are the number of non-zero bins in this case).

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scFilterBarcodes` scans a BAM file for cell barcodes (stored in a BAM tag, `BC` by default) and reports how many genomic bins each barcode has reads in. Barcodes can be matched against a whitelist, allowing some Hamming distance, and filtered by a minimum number of non-zero bins. This is typically the first step to find which barcodes correspond to real cells.
-----
**Inputs**
- A coordinate-sorted BAM file with a cell barcode tag. - Optionally, a single-column whitelist of expected barcodes.
**Outputs**
- A table of detected barcodes with their bin count and whether they passed the filters. The `selected` barcodes can be used as the whitelist (`--barcodes`) for the other sincei tools. - Optionally, a barcode rank ("knee") plot.
**Note:** the rank plot cannot be drawn when all barcodes have the same count. @HELP_FOOTER@
